data.body:
[P3] Preserve the request ID when recording malformed outputs

Both parsing factories receive the invocation's request ID, but discard it when raising `InvalidInvocationOutputError`. This branch then invents a UUID, which `GetDurableExecutionHistory` exposes as `InvocationCompletedDetails.RequestId`. Consequently, malformed-output failures cannot be correlated with the actual invocation using that field. Carry the request ID on the exception and pass it into `record_invocation_completion`; add a test asserting that malformed-output history retains the supplied ID.
